intro: Fizzle's Claw is the severed hand of the goblin warlock Fizzle Darkstorm. Taken from his encampment in Thunder Ridge, it serves as physical proof to the Horde commanders in Razor Hill that a dangerous Burning Blade conspirator has been slain.

p: Orgnil Soulscar, tasked with uprooting shadow cults threatening the orcish homeland, identified Fizzle Darkstorm as an instigator spreading corruption in Thunder Ridge. Demand for Fizzle's claw was not merely out of savagery, but practical necessity: the Horde requires indisputable evidence when a covert warlock operating under the banner of the Burning Blade is eliminated.

Thunder Ridge lies just northwest of Razor Hill, making Fizzle's cultist presence an imminent peril to the surrounding territories. By severing the goblin's claw and returning it to Razor Hill, Horde scouts confirmed that the warlock's rituals and his attempts to establish a Burning Blade foothold had been thwarted.
